notes.title: Please migrate to the full version
notes.content:
Thank you for participating in the beta test.
Please uninstall the Playtest version and then install the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3060770/]full version[/url].

[h2]Migration Steps[/h2]

1. Close SteamVR.

2. Uninstall the PlayTest version (Shiftall VR Manager Playtest) from your Steam Library.
Steam Library gear icon > Manage > Uninstall
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234474/a065b1be5da843b2ef0ae96ee30318c717b4bc7a.png[/img]

3. Install [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3060770]Shiftall VR Manager[/url].

4. Ensure SteamVR is not running before launching the application for the first time. The SteamVR driver will be installed.

[h2]Important Notes[/h2]

 - Settings from the PlayTest version will not carry over to the full version.

 - The SteamVR driver will be uninstalled and reinstalled during both the uninstallation of the PlayTest version and the first launch of the full version. Make sure to perform the migration while SteamVR is not running.

[url=https://manual.shiftall.net/vrmanager/] VR Manager beta testing program[/url]


Version 0.1.12 
Released on Steam. Added shoulder estimation, less CPU load and stability improvement when using GX dongle. Improved Bluetooth connection. Experimental implementation of the Fixed HIP function (7/Oct)

Version 0.1.13 
Fixed repeated sensor power off issue when using GX dongle. Added warning if the intended body part is not set. (9/Oct)



[b]Important Notes for Installing the Steam Playtest Version[/b]
Be sure to uninstall the old version of the installer before proceeding with the Steam Playtest version.
All settings will be removed when you uninstall the application.

Do not run SteamVR when uninstalling. If SteamVR is running, uninstalling the SteamVR driver may fail.
After installing the Steam Playtest version, the SteamVR driver will be installed the first time you start SteamVR. Again, make sure SteamVR is not running at this time.
